title: Caption-aware ripple DeleteClip (video-only and linked audio)
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: DeleteClip(ripple:true) now applies the same caption and marker interval crop/split/shift as RippleDeleteClips. On a persistent-audio timeline it delegates to RippleDeleteClips so linked members are removed together and later content closes the vacated interval. It is not refused as CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and is not rewritten as LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

A spanning cue keeps authored text; the portion inside the closed interval is cropped and the portion after is shifted. Caption geometry matches RippleDeleteClips (remnant ids may differ). Source uncover is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. A locked partner is FIELD_LOCKED.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits at one second, adds a spanning cue, uses Ripple delete range on the left pair, undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in. The same persist path is also exercised with DeleteClip(ripple:true) through the SDK.

Leave-gap DeleteClip with captions still refuses CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Leave-gap TrimClip still does not shift later content and still leaves an absolute remnant in the vacated gap. MoveClip with captions still refuses CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap trim, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen RippleTrimClip, video-only and linked-audio TrimClip(ripple:true), reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, split and leave-gap rebind/remnants, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, leave-gap DeleteClip with captions, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
